newsitem.title: UK: UK retailer Heal's plans March 24 flotation.
newsitem.headline: UK retailer Heal's plans March 24 flotation.

text.p: Luxury furnishings retailer Heal's Plc said on Thursday it plans to list on the London Stock Exchange on March 24 via a 12.0 million stg placing raising 1.75 million stg of new money.
The float will allow NatWest Ventures to realise its investment in the up-market retailer, which was set up after a management buy-out from Storehouse Plc in 1990.

The management shareholders will also be realising some of their investment, the company said. Heal's, which said it was one of the most prestigious names in UK retailing, has two stores in London and one in Guildford, Surrey.

The proceeds from the float, sponsored by Close Brothers with SocGen as broker, will be invested in the group's existing stores and in sites for new stores in the UK and Republic of Ireland, the company said.
